title: Institutional occupancies.
officialText:
The amounts shown in Table 1103.1 shall be reduced by 50 percent for all areas of
institutional occupancies except kitchens, laboratories and mortuaries. The total of all Group A2, B2, A3 and B3 refrigerants
shall not exceed 550 pounds (250 kg) in occupied areas or machinery rooms. Nothing in this section shall be construed to allow
the use of Group A3 and B3 refrigerants if otherwise prohibited.
